description: Player 0 bearing off: 2 checkers at point 3, 3 checkers at point 5 (10 already borne off). Player 1 has a blot on point 2. Dice [1,3].
notes: Player 0 can hit the blot at 2 while bearing off. Bearing off is still active because all checkers remain in home board (hitting doesn't remove them from home). After hitting, bear-off continues if player 0 doesn't re-enter from bar.
